take.title_zh: Claude Design 引爆設計工具重組：AI 從輔助走向主導
take.title_en: Claude Design Reshapes the Design Tool Landscape: AI Takes the Lead
take.body_zh:
Anthropic 在四月推出 Claude Design，讓任何人能用對話生成互動原型，直接瞄準 Figma 與 Canva。Figma 股價短暫下跌 7%，但隨即以超越預期的 Q1 財報和上修全年展望回應市場，顯示成熟平台的護城河不易短期攻破。

更深層的轉變是使用者門檻的急速下降：PM 和行銷人員不再需要等待設計師才能看到第一個原型。2026 年，AI 驅動的設計工具棧——Claude Design、Paper.design 等——正在讓「AI-first 設計」成為新的工作流程標準，prompt 工程能力將成為設計師最重要的新技能。
take.body_en:
Anthropic's Claude Design upended the design tool landscape in April, enabling anyone to generate interactive prototypes through conversation — directly targeting Figma and Canva. Figma's stock dipped 7% on the news, but the company steadied with Q1 2026 earnings that beat expectations and a raised full-year outlook, signaling that mature platforms still hold meaningful moats.

The deeper shift is structural: as AI lowers the barrier to design execution, PMs and marketers can generate first-draft prototypes without waiting on designers. In 2026, AI-first design tooling — Claude Design, Paper.design, and beyond — is becoming the default workflow, and prompt fluency is the new essential design skill.

articles.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Design：2 個 Prompt 從零到可交付原型
articles.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Design: From Zero to Prototype in 2 Prompts
articles.summary_zh: Anthropic 旗下 Anthropic Labs 正式推出 Claude Design，由 Claude Opus 4.7 驅動。使用者只需以對話描述需求，即可產出視覺設計、互動原型、投影片與行銷一頁式素材，不需任何設計背景。成品支援匯出為 Canva、PDF、PPTX 或獨立 HTML，也可透過組織內部 URL 分享。這是 Anthropic 首度正式進入視覺創作市場，直接挑戰 Figma 與 Canva，讓 AI 生成設計稿從工具實驗走向主流應用。
articles.summary_en: Anthropic's Claude Design, powered by Claude Opus 4.7, lets anyone generate polished visuals, interactive prototypes, slide decks, and marketing one-pagers through natural conversation — no design background required. Outputs export to Canva, PDF, PPTX, or standalone HTML, shareable via internal org URLs. The launch marks Anthropic's first direct move into visual creation, squarely challenging Figma and Canva.
articles.take_zh: 當 AI 把從零到原型壓縮成兩個 prompt，設計師的差異化不再是執行速度，而是判斷力與策略直覺——Claude Design 重新定義了誰能做設計。
articles.take_en: When prototyping takes two prompts, a designer's edge shifts from execution to judgment and strategy. Claude Design redefined who can do design.

articles.title_zh: Figma 股價跌 7% 後逆轉：Q1 超預期、全年展望上修
articles.title_en: Figma Stock Dips 7% on Claude Design, Then Rebounds on Strong Q1
articles.summary_zh: Claude Design 發布後 Figma 股價立即下跌約 7%，市場擔憂 Anthropic 直攻視覺設計領域。Figma 隨後公布 2026 Q1 財報，營收超越市場預期且全年展望上修，股市情緒迅速回穩。分析師指出，Figma 在企業客戶的深度協作生態與版本控管功能，仍是 Claude Design 短期難以複製的護城河。這場市場反應顯示：即使是設計平台龍頭，也無法迴避 AI 顛覆帶來的估值壓力。
articles.summary_en: Figma's stock dropped ~7% immediately after the Claude Design announcement as investors worried about Anthropic entering the design market. Figma then reported Q1 2026 earnings that beat revenue expectations and raised its full-year outlook, stabilizing confidence. Analysts cite Figma's enterprise collaboration ecosystem and version control as durable moats — but AI disruption pressure on valuations is clearly real.
articles.take_zh: Figma 的 Q1 財報是一顆定心丸，但 Anthropic 進場的事實不會消失。企業整合護得住今天，誰的 AI 功能跑得更快才是明天的關鍵。
articles.take_en: Figma's Q1 beat buys confidence, but Anthropic's market entry is permanent. Enterprise depth protects today; AI velocity will determine tomorrow.

articles.title_zh: Claude Design 進場：終結 Figma 時代，還是另一個 AI 工具？
articles.title_en: Claude Design Launch: End of the Figma Era or Just Another AI Tool?
articles.summary_zh: The New Stack 分析 Claude Design 的市場定位，指出其核心差異在於「端到端生成」——使用者從概念描述到可交付物，不需切換任何工具。Claude Opus 4.7 在視覺理解與生成品質上領先多數 AI 設計工具。批評者指出，缺乏版本控管、協作評論與設計系統整合等企業功能，讓 Claude Design 短期難以在大型設計團隊取代 Figma，但獨立設計師和小型團隊已有充分理由切換。
articles.summary_en: The New Stack analyzes Claude Design's positioning, highlighting end-to-end generation as its core differentiator — concept to deliverable without switching tools. Claude Opus 4.7 delivers strong visual quality. Critics note the absence of version control, inline comments, and design system integration means enterprise teams won't abandon Figma overnight, but solo creators and small teams have genuine reasons to switch.
articles.take_zh: Claude Design 對獨立設計師和小型團隊吸引力很強，但進入企業設計流程還需要補齊 Figma 花了十年建立的協作基礎設施。
articles.take_en: Claude Design is compelling for solos and small teams, but enterprise adoption requires a decade's worth of collaboration infrastructure that doesn't yet exist.

articles.title_zh: Anthropic Claude Design 同台競技 Adobe 與 Figma
articles.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Design Steps Into Adobe and Figma's Territory
articles.summary_zh: PYMNTS 分析指出，Anthropic 的 Claude Design 不只是 Figma 的對手，更直接切入 Adobe 的創意工具生態圈。其最大差異在於「端到端生成」，從概念到可交付物不需切換工具。然而市場也在觀察：Claude Design 能否在缺少版本控管、協作評論等企業功能的情況下，真正替代 Figma 在大型組織中的角色？短期內，Claude Design 更可能成為 Figma 的補充工具，而非直接替代品。
articles.summary_en: PYMNTS analysis positions Claude Design as a challenger to both Figma and Adobe's broader creative suite. The tool's end-to-end generation — concept to deliverable without switching apps — is its sharpest differentiator. The open question: can Claude Design win enterprise adoption without collaboration features like version control and inline commenting that Figma has spent years building? Near-term, it's more likely a complement than a replacement.
articles.take_zh: 從 prompt 到成品不換工具是 Claude Design 最大亮點，但企業設計流程的複雜度遠不止生成這一步，協作與版本管理仍是 Figma 的護城河。
articles.take_en: One-prompt-to-deliverable is compelling, but enterprise design demands more than generation — it demands iteration, collaboration, and version control Figma has spent years perfecting.

articles.title_zh: 2026 PM 必備 AI 工具：Linear、Granola、PostHog 成新標配
articles.title_en: 2026 PM AI Stack: Linear, Granola, and PostHog Are the New Defaults
articles.summary_zh: 根據最新產業報告，超過 70% 的產品經理在 2026 年已將 AI 工具納入每日工作流程，較前一年翻倍。三款工具成為新標配：Linear 以 AI 自動分類提升專案管理效率，Granola 在不需機器人入會的情況下自動產生會議筆記，PostHog 整合 Session Replay、Feature Flag 與 A/B 測試於單一平台。這三款工具分別覆蓋執行、溝通與數據三大場景，代表 PM 工具棧正式進入 AI 標配時代。
articles.summary_en: Over 70% of PMs now use AI tools daily in 2026, double the prior year. The leading stack: Linear for AI-powered project management with auto-triage, Granola for meeting notes without a bot joining calls, and PostHog for product analytics combining session replay, feature flags, and A/B testing. Together they cover execution, communication, and data — the three core PM workflow pillars.
articles.take_zh: PM 工具的 AI 化已過臨界點。Linear、Granola、PostHog 各自搞定一個核心場景，讓 PM 的時間真正從整理資訊轉向做決策。
articles.take_en: AI adoption in PM has crossed the tipping point. Linear, Granola, and PostHog each own a workflow pillar, collectively shifting PM time from organizing information to making decisions.

articles.title_zh: AI PM 工作流程雙層架構：生產力層 vs 能力層
articles.title_en: The Two-Layer AI PM Framework: Productivity vs Capability
articles.summary_zh: Productside 提出 2026 年 AI PM 工具的雙層架構分析：「生產力層」負責削減日常瑣事，如自動撰寫 PRD、摘要會議、更新狀態；「能力層」則在海量數據中辨識模式，協助 PM 發現用戶行為趨勢與市場信號。目前多數 PM 仍停留在生產力層，尚未充分發揮能力層的策略價值——這正是未來兩年 PM 角色分化的關鍵戰場。
articles.summary_en: Productside analysts describe 2026 AI PM tooling as a two-layer system: a productivity layer cutting busywork (auto-writing PRDs, meeting summaries, status updates) and a capability layer surfacing patterns at scale — behavioral trends and market signals invisible to humans alone. Most PMs today operate mainly in the productivity layer, leaving the strategic capability layer significantly underutilized — the key differentiator for PM roles going forward.
articles.take_zh: 能用 AI 省時間只是入門；能用 AI 看到別人看不到的洞察，才是 2026 年 PM 真正的競爭優勢。
articles.take_en: Saving time with AI is table stakes. Using AI to surface insights others miss — that's the real competitive edge for PMs in 2026.

articles.title_zh: Paper.design：為 AI Agent 時代打造的設計 × Code 協作畫布
articles.title_en: Paper.design: The Agent-Native Canvas Bridging Design and Code
articles.summary_zh: Paper 是一款以 Web 標準（HTML/CSS）為底層的 AI 協作設計畫布，專為 AI Agent 工作流程設計。與 Figma 最大不同在於：設計 Token 與元件可與程式碼庫雙向同步，讓 AI Coding Agent 能自動更新設計文件而不需人工介入，大幅壓低設計與工程間的交接成本。目前特別受採用 AI Coding Agent 的小型敏捷團隊歡迎，被定位為「設計即代碼」工作流程的實踐工具。
articles.summary_en: Paper is an AI agent-native design canvas built on web standards (HTML/CSS). Unlike Figma, Paper allows design tokens and components to sync bidirectionally with a codebase, enabling AI coding agents to automatically update design documents without human handoff. This dramatically reduces design-to-engineering friction and is gaining traction with small agile teams already running AI coding workflows.
articles.take_zh: Paper 的 Agent 可讀設計預示著下一代設計工具的方向：設計稿不只給人看，也要讓 AI 直接拿去寫程式——這是 Figma 目前架構難以快速轉型的方向。
articles.take_en: Paper's agent-readable design points to where tooling is heading: artifacts built for AI to code against, not just for humans to review — a paradigm Figma's architecture wasn't designed for.
